messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: TRN-021 port 1/1/3 CRC errors climbing since the storm last night. Link up, optics -6 dBm. What should I check first?

messages.author: Aino Asiantuntija
messages.text: On the TX-3000s I always start with the connectors. After thunderstorms we've had dirty or damaged patch connectors at Hervanta twice. Clean and inspect both ends before anything else.

messages.author: Mikko Mäkelä
messages.text: I disagree, connectors were fine last time. On TX-3000 the line card gets into a bad state after power dips - reseat the line card, that fixed TRN-001 in May.

messages.author: Aino Asiantuntija
messages.text: Reseating takes the whole card's traffic down. Connectors first, it's cheaper.

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Cleaned connectors, CRC count dropped but not zero. Leaving it under monitoring.
